schema.purpose: Machine-readable canonical whitelist of expected-RED / retired executable snapshots for the Line Theorem witness repository. Round-pinned auditor snapshots assert a PRIOR revision's exact state and go RED by design when that state is later repaired; they are never 'fixed' and never count as findings. This file gives them the manuscript path, per-artifact hash, and row schema the GPT-Pro referee (finding 12, 2026-07-31) found missing.

row_fields.id: artifact filename in the repository root
row_fields.expected_signature: verified behaviour: 'exit_nonzero' (red by design), 'exit_zero' (documented green archive), or 'non_executable'
row_fields.pins: the prior-revision state this snapshot asserts
row_fields.red_since: the revision at which the pinned state was repaired, making this artifact go red
row_fields.sha256: SHA-256 of the artifact as of rev-3.11 (immutable pin target)
row_fields.verified_rc: actual exit code observed on the rev-3.11 tree (2026-07-31)

schema.gate_rule: Everything else in the repository root must be GREEN under its documented invocation; any other red is a finding. When a repair moves state that an auditor snapshot pins, ADD THE SNAPSHOT HERE in the same commit as the repair (POST-AUDIT-FOLD-CHECKLIST.md lines 100-102).

manuscript.manuscript_circulation_note: paper-3b.tex is an internal working copy, not for circulation until rev-4; it is NOT shipped inside the rev-3.11-witness tag. The hash above pins provenance only. check_theorem_graph.py G7/G7b require this source to run in full (see PUSH-PLAN).
manuscript.canonical_source_of_rows: POST-AUDIT-FOLD-CHECKLIST.md, section 'EXPECTED-RED WHITELIST' (round-11 M5, extended through round-13)
